description: This file defines the 'NotesFlow' class, a reusable orchestration layer for CRUD operations on notes. It acts as a single entry point for note API routes, managing interactions with the database via the sqlite_db adapter and handling errors. It provides methods for ensuring database schema, listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Orchestration layer for notes use-cases, providing methods for managing notes in the database.

methods.name: None ensure_ready(self)
methods.description: Ensures the database schema exists, creating tables and indexes if necessary.

methods.name: list[sqlite_db.NoteRow] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes.

methods.name: sqlite_db.NoteRow|None get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID; returns None if not found.

methods.name: sqlite_db.NoteRow create_note(self, *, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with the provided title and content, returning the created note.

methods.name: sqlite_db.NoteRow|None update_note(self, *, note_id: int, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Updates a note identified by note_id with new title and content; returns the updated note or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, *, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID; returns True if deletion was successful, False otherwise.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_note(self, *, title: str, content: str) -> sqlite_db.NoteRow:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_note(self, note_id: int) -> sqlite_db.NoteRow | None:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_note(self, *, note_id: int, title: str, content: str) -> sqlite_db.NoteRow | None/
ctags.signature: (self, *, note_id: int, title: str, content: str)
